'''Teemo''' the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] was a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] and a member of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]], who operated out of his [[Teemo's palace/Legends|palace]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Shuuta/Legends|Mos Shuuta]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Biography==
Teemo was the ''de facto'' ruler of Mos Shuuta, a small city on the desert world of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="Escape from Mos Shutta">{{FFG|story=Escape from Mos Shuuta|book=Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Beginner Game|text=''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Beginner Game}}</ref> He was a Hutt crime lord of considerable influence, thanks to his relation to the illustrious [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]].<ref name="The Long Arm of the Hutt">{{FFG|story=The Long Arm of the Hutt|book=Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Beginner Game|text=''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Beginner Game}}</ref> For various reasons, he made enemies of [[Pash]], [[Oskara]], [[41-VEX]], and [[Lowhhrick/Legends|Lowhhrick]].<ref name="Escape from Mos Shutta" /> He also went against the Hutt Cartel, secretly reverse engineering [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|Battle Droids]] and misrepresenting the amount of [[Ryll/Legends|Ryll]] he was importing from his [[Mine/Legends|mines]] on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]].<ref name="The Long Arm of the Hutt" />
